chapterTitle: FBISE Full-Book Annual Exam Simulator II (Comprehensive All Units 10–18)
subject: biology-10

questions.question: What is the approximate concentration of carbon dioxide in normal exhaled human breath? (FBISE 2024)
questions.explanation: Exhaled air contains approximately 4% carbon dioxide, a hundred-fold increase over the 0.04% in inhaled atmospheric air.

questions.question: Which adapted plants possess broad floating leaves with stomata restricted entirely to the upper epidermis? (FBISE 2023)
questions.explanation: Hydrophytes floating on water maintain stomata exclusively on upper surfaces in direct contact with ambient air.

questions.question: The hormone thyroxine that regulates basal metabolic rate is synthesized by which endocrine gland?
questions.explanation: The thyroid gland secretes thyroxine to govern cellular oxidation, protein synthesis, and metabolic heat generation.

questions.question: The microscopic structural repeating columns comprising compact bone tissue are called:
questions.explanation: Osteons are the structural units of compact bone, featuring concentric lamellae surrounding a neurovascular canal.

questions.question: In potato plants, vegetative propagation takes place through underground stem structures known as: (FBISE 2022)
questions.explanation: Potato tubers are fleshy underground stem storage organs possessing nodal buds (eyes) that sprout into new shoots.

questions.question: Watson and Crick model of DNA established that the double helix is held together by hydrogen bonds between: (FBISE 2024)
questions.explanation: Hydrogen bonds between complementary purine-pyrimidine base pairs (A=T and G≡C) hold the two DNA strands together.

questions.question: The biological process wherein agricultural fertilizer runoff causes excessive aquatic algal growth and oxygen depletion is: (FBISE 2023)
questions.explanation: Eutrophication occurs when excess phosphate and nitrate runoff induces dense algal blooms that deplete dissolved oxygen upon decay.

questions.question: Which endangered blind aquatic mammal is endemic to the Indus River system in Pakistan? (FBISE 2021)
questions.explanation: The Indus river dolphin (Platanista minor) is an endangered freshwater cetacean native exclusively to Pakistans Indus River.

questions.question: Which enzyme functions as molecular scissors to cut DNA at specific palindromic recognition sequences in biotechnology?
questions.explanation: Restriction endonucleases recognize specific palindromic DNA sequences and cleave phosphodiester bonds.

questions.question: The antibiotic penicillin acts therapeutically by inhibiting which bacterial metabolic process? (FBISE 2024)
questions.explanation: Penicillin inhibits transpeptidase enzymes that cross-link peptidoglycan, causing osmotic lysis of dividing bacteria.

questions.question: Which psychoactive drug class causes distortions in sensory perception and vivid hallucinations without external stimuli?
questions.explanation: Hallucinogens profoundly alter sensory processing in the cerebrum, generating vivid perceptual hallucinations.

questions.question: Which type of acquired immunity is conferred when an infant receives pre-formed maternal antibodies across the placenta or via colostrum?
questions.explanation: Maternal IgG transferred via placenta or IgA via breast milk provides natural passive immunity without creating infant memory cells.
